description: Defines the evidence a future Stage-6 diagnostic comparison must provide before admission (ADMISSIBLE/LIMITED/UNAVAILABLE/INVALID), including version provenance, group disclosure, effective N, availability, reproducibility, missingness, descriptive direction, and prohibited inference.
scope: future Stage 6 diagnostic comparisons (student vs reference distribution)

statements.statement: A comparison artifact must carry corpus_package_id, manifest_hash, FeatureSetVersion, ReferenceGroupVersion, DistributionVersion, requested and resolved group, effective N, availability, reproducibility, missingness, and provenance.
Student and corpus feature versions must match exactly; mismatch yields UNAVAILABLE, never best-effort comparability.
Fallback resolution must be disclosed per artifact; fallback use yields LIMITED.
Effective N below 30, ARG13/ARG19 standalone, missing distributions, or license-restricted operations yield UNAVAILABLE.
Missingness is never imputed; n_missing and validity flags are reported; elevated missingness yields LIMITED.
Comparison direction is descriptive only; normative wording yields INVALID.
Proficiency/mastery/learning-gain/CEFR wording, causal or transfer claims, cross-version comparisons, and score fields yield INVALID.
Circular use of the 270 scored block (construction and evaluation from the same block) yields INVALID.
Learner-facing corpus output remains disabled by default; exposure without the D-08 display policy and licensing gate yields INVALID.
The diagnostic algorithm, band method, and thresholds are not defined by this policy; they remain Researcher decisions (D4).
